screens.name: Main Task List
screens.purpose: Display all tasks and provide access to all task management functions

key_components.name: App Header
key_components.interaction: Displays app title and branding

key_components.name: Add Task Button
key_components.interaction: Opens task creation form when clicked

key_components.name: Task List Container
key_components.interaction: Displays all tasks from the tasks table, scrollable if needed

key_components.name: Task Item
key_components.interaction: Shows task title, description, and completion status; contains action buttons

key_components.name: Complete Checkbox
key_components.interaction: Toggles is_completed status in tasks table when clicked

key_components.name: Edit Button
key_components.interaction: Opens edit form for the selected task

key_components.name: Delete Button
key_components.interaction: Shows confirmation dialog, then deletes task from tasks table

key_components.name: Empty State
key_components.interaction: Displays when no tasks exist, encourages user to create first task

screens.name: Create Task Modal
screens.purpose: Allow users to input details for a new task

key_components.name: Modal Overlay
key_components.interaction: Darkens background and focuses attention on form

key_components.name: Task Title Input
key_components.interaction: Accepts user input for task title (required field)

key_components.name: Task Description Input
key_components.interaction: Accepts user input for task description (optional field)

key_components.name: Save Button
key_components.interaction: Validates input and inserts new record into tasks table

key_components.name: Cancel Button
key_components.interaction: Closes modal without saving

screens.name: Edit Task Modal
screens.purpose: Allow users to modify existing task details

key_components.name: Modal Overlay
key_components.interaction: Darkens background and focuses attention on form

key_components.name: Task Title Input
key_components.interaction: Pre-filled with current title, accepts modifications

key_components.name: Task Description Input
key_components.interaction: Pre-filled with current description, accepts modifications

key_components.name: Update Button
key_components.interaction: Validates input and updates record in tasks table

key_components.name: Cancel Button
key_components.interaction: Closes modal without saving changes

screens.name: Delete Confirmation Dialog
screens.purpose: Confirm user intent before permanently deleting a task

key_components.name: Dialog Box
key_components.interaction: Displays confirmation message with task title

key_components.name: Confirm Delete Button
key_components.interaction: Deletes task record from tasks table and closes dialog

key_components.name: Cancel Button
key_components.interaction: Closes dialog without deleting
